directives.text: Lead every post with the most striking grounded number, using conditional language for any interpretation and never trading a fact for a click.
Set conviction scores to reflect the near-term trade setup (R:R, overbought/oversold), not just the long-term narrative; separate 'long-term constructive' from 'trade-ready bullish'.
Use only chart levels with at least 2 touches as support/resistance; label single-touch levels as 'tentative level (1 touch)' and exclude them from all R:R calculations.
Consolidate repeated ticker coverage into one daily watch post per stock, merging earnings, news, and technicals; do not post separate entries for the same ticker.
Limit market-cap top-20 posts to weekly or only when a notable reshuffle occurs; never post daily.
Trim headlines to under 15 words, leading with the key number or move, and vary emoji usage across posts.
